messages:
maria: Quick pulse — changelog cutoff for SDK v1.9 is Fri 2024-06-07 18:00 PT. Who's taking docs + quickstarts updates? Also the sampleapp depends on internal lib `rwdx-core` which may need a semver bump. Please confirm owners and any blockers. @jon @kevin :wave:

jon: I'll own quickstarts. Will open PRs to update snippets and sample flow today. ETA EOD PST. I'll also run smoke locally: `./scripts/smoke.sh sampleapp` :white_check_mark:

kevin: I'll handle docs and changelog entries. One blocker: CI is flaky on macos-latest for the sampleapp (selenium timeout). Filed ENG-4321. If it's not fixed by the cutoff I'll mark it as a known issue in the changelog. :thinking_face:

sara: FYI release infra needs the sampleapp image to be built with `make docker-build` and tagged. devex-bot has been failing checks when the tag is missing. I'll try a quick CI matrix tweak to skip macOS runners for the build phase.

maria: Thanks — plan is: freeze at 18:00 PT. If you need a late entry, ping me with a one-line justification + risk assessment. Also reminder to include migration notes for the breaking change in `embed()` signature in the SDK changelog. :memo:

jon: noted. tagging @devex-bot to run the dry-run checklist now.

devex-bot: Dry-run checklist started: https://internal/release/runs/3240009876. Smoke tests queued (sampleapp, quickstart-snippets). Logs will appear in the run page.

kevin: Can someone review my docs PR #402? It's small (copy + updated code samples).

sara: I can review in ~2h. If CI flake blocks merge, we'll either merge with a follow-up or add test skip + note.

maria: If the macOS CI flake persists past cutoff, fallback plan: attach screenshots and run `make smoke-local` instructions in the release notes so customers can reproduce locally. Keep the changelog brief but explicit about the workaround.

jon: I'll also add a short entry in quickstarts about the docker tag and include the `make docker-build` snippet.

kevin: thanks — assigning PR review to @sara and @maria for final signoff. :pray:

maria: Great. Ping here when PRs are merged so I can assemble the final changelog slice. Good luck everyone. :rocket:
